comment: An image pull failure's next step, from the pull error. pkg/agentsandbox (nextsteps_test.go) and its k8s-ui mirror (resource-utils-agent-runtimes.test.ts) both read these vectors. dns: the next step is the registry's DNS; otherwise neither names one, and the reason's general step stands.
registryDNSNextStep: Check the registry hostname in the Pod template’s image, and that the nodes’ DNS resolves it

cases.name: back-off over a lookup that found no such host (the live test cluster)
cases.message: Back-off pulling image "registry.invalid/does-not-exist:1": ErrImagePull: failed to pull and unpack image "registry.invalid/does-not-exist:1": failed to resolve reference "registry.invalid/does-not-exist:1": failed to do request: Head "https://registry.invalid/v2/does-not-exist/manifests/1": dial tcp: lookup registry.invalid on 10.0.0.2:53: no such host

cases.name: the DNS server answers server misbehaving
cases.message: failed to pull and unpack image "registry.corp.example/agent:1": failed to resolve reference "registry.corp.example/agent:1": failed to do request: Head "https://registry.corp.example/v2/agent/manifests/1": dial tcp: lookup registry.corp.example on 127.0.0.53:53: server misbehaving
